newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Manager of Czech state bond issue sets min price.
newsitem.headline: Manager of Czech state bond issue sets min price.

text.p: OFT Brokers, manager of the Czech Finance Ministry's state bond auction, said on Friday that its 654.25 million crown ($23.6 million) five-year state bond auction would have a minimum price of 101.73 percent.
The auction will be on Monday and the bonds, which were issued in August when only 1.9 billion crowns worth were actually sold, will bear a 10.95-percent fixed coupon.

On Monday, OFT held an auction of the bonds where 2.2 billion crowns worth of bids were accepted. Average price in the auction was 101.43 percent, the maximum price was 101.65 percent and the minimum price was 101.23 percent
OFT said the minimum amount sold would be five million crowns. Price will be the main factor in evaluating bids, followed by amount.
Auctions will continue every Monday until the whole amount is sold.
-- Dusan Bucanek, Prague Newsroom, 42-2-2423-0003 ($ = 27.70 Czech Crowns)
